newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Jil Sander to launch men's collection in 97.
newsitem.headline: German Jil Sander to launch men's collection in 97.

text.p: German fashion group Jil Sander AG best-known for simple and elegant women's fashions, on Monday announced it will present its first men's collection next January.
The collection, to include suits, coats, shirts, jackets, ties, shoes and leather accessories, will be designed for the Fall/Winter 1997/1998 season and be presented in Milan.

Sticking to its exclusive marketing concept, the Hamburg-based group founded and run by designer Jil Sander, will not license the new collection but rather produce and distribute the fashions itself. It will select 100 stores to sell the new collection.
"Jil Sander combines quality and design with her progressive collection and meets the demands on the modern man," the group said in a mandatory statement.
The group earlier this year predicted 1996 sales to rise a minimum five percent but for profits to only match 1995 levels.
